attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Georgia military retirement exemption (2025). Age-based tiers: Under 62 = $17.5k base + $17.5k if earned income >= $17.5k, 62-64 = $35k, 65+ = $65k. Moving to $65k for all ages in 2026. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, GA DOR.

Calculates Georgia state income tax per Form 500. Georgia uses a flat tax rate of 5.19% (2025) with standard deductions of $12,000 (Single) or $24,000 (MFJ). Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status, and calculates tax at flat rate.

initial_action.action_dsl: add "GEORGIA FORM 500 - State Income Tax Calculation" to job.audit_trail; set result.ga_agi = result.agi
initial_action.action_postfix: "GEORGIA FORM 500 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.ga_agi xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate GA tax for MFJ; Apply MFJ standard deduction ($24,000) and calculate tax at 5.19%. NOTE: GA_edd lacks ga_standard_deduction_{mfj,single} and ga_tax_rate constants (only military exemption fields are defined); EL uses the postfix-named symbols.
action_details.action_dsl: add " Starting Federal AGI: $" + result.ga_agi + " (Form 1040 Line 11)" to job.audit_trail; set result.ga_standard_deduction = ga_standard_deduction_mfj; add " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" + result.ga_standard_deduction + " (Form 500 Line 9)" to job.audit_trail; set result.ga_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.ga_agi - result.ga_standard_deduction) and 0.0; add " Georgia Taxable Income: $" + result.ga_taxable_income + " (AGI - Standard Deduction)" to job.audit_trail; set result.ga_tax = result.ga_taxable_income * ga_tax_rate; add " Georgia Tax (5.19%): $" + result.ga_tax + " (Form 500 Line 16)" to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.ga_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto ga_standard_deduction_mfj /result.ga_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.ga_standard_deduction cvs strconcat " (Form 500 Line 9)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ga_agi result.ga_standard_deduction f- 0 fmax /result.ga_taxable_income xdef " Georgia Taxable Income: $" result.ga_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Standard Deduction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ga_taxable_income ga_tax_rate f* /result.ga_tax xdef " Georgia Tax (5.19%): $" result.ga_tax cvs strconcat " (Form 500 Line 16)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
